privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: my_pet stores your pets' data in your own Firebase project. There are no analytics on the content of your records. Your partner can read your data; nobody else.

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.subtitle: Erases pets, vaccines, family and your account.
deleteAll.confirmBody: This can't be undone. We'll erase every pet, vaccine record, your family and your account from {appName}.
deleteAll.partnerBlockBody: We can't erase the account while it's shared with someone else. Removing partners isn't available yet — sign out for now.
deleteAll.requiresRecentLogin: For security, sign out and sign back in, then try again.
